attempts.summary: Locked curl (8.12.1-4.el10) at its current version on node1 using dnf versionlock, confirmed a simulated system update excludes it, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and versionlock state, rebooted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed a changed boot_id (proving an actual restart, not just elapsed time), and verified post-restart that curl's version and the versionlock entry persisted with the system fully healthy.
